ns2:section.sectionText: Planning and Implementing Clinical Trials Social interventions, ranging from both micro-level clinical practices to policy-level interventions, are omnipresent in Social Work. This course focuses on the fundamentals of planning and implementing clinical trials. Strong emphasis is placed on conceptualizing novel theory-based interventions, the ethical design of trials that test interventions’ efficacy and the relevance of interventions to disenfranchised populations.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign. Restricted to PHD:Social Work -UIUC.
